# Web Portfolio

This website is the personal portfolio of Deepthi Mahendran. It contains information about her projects, skills, education, and ways to contact her.

- [Skills](https://deepthi-mahendran.vercel.app/skills)

- [Contact](https://deepthi-mahendran.vercel.app/contact)
